name: Pass 22 quality-refinery hardening
goal: Ensure expert rubric and refinery gate validators cannot bless weakened thresholds, unresolved failed points, or failed pass gates.
risks: A caller could lower the rubric threshold and pass a weak panel
A low rubric check could be marked as risk without fix evidence
A refinery gate could say pass while core checks failed or evidence was empty

nodes.label: Pass 22 quality-gate critic review

node_contract.what: Review quality-refinery validators against transcript proof requirements.
node_contract.why: Expert rubrics and refinery gates are the acceptance boundary for every serious artifact.
node_contract.how: Prove low-threshold and bad-pass bypasses with temporary fixtures.
node_contract.where: score_rubric_matrix.py, validate_refinery_gate.py, templates, and hardening runner.
node_contract.who: Codex using governance, quality, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: Each finding is reproducible and tied to a regression check.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any accepted finding becomes a validator patch and hardening-runner negative case.

nodes.label: Quality-refinery validator hardening

node_contract.what: Patch rubric and refinery validators plus live skill guidance.
node_contract.why: Future quality certificates must not be based on weakened gates.
node_contract.how: Edit installed scripts/templates, sync workspace copies, and add positive and negative fixtures.
node_contract.where: df-quality-refinery skill and codex-skills validation suite.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before final validation.
node_contract.how_good: Positive fixtures pass and the new negative fixtures fail.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every change.

nodes.label: Pass 22 verification sweep

node_contract.why: The fix only counts if the executable suite proves the new gates.
node_contract.how: Run the DFMS hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 22 records.
node_contract.when: After all patches and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
